blocks.text: MIAMI— Upon review, Minnesota’s LaMelo Ball traveled. Really, really traveled. The association that represents NBA referees posted a clip from Wednesday night’s game between the Timberwolves and the Miami Heat and clarified — not that it needed much clarification — that Ball indeed did commit a violation on his way to a 3-pointer in the second quarter of Minnesota’s win.
